Synthesis of an online debate*: Two things distinguish food production from all other productive activities: first, every single person needs food each day and has a right to it; and second, it is hugely dependent on nature.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 粮食生产有两点不同于其他一切生产活动：第一，每个人每天都需要食物，而且都有获得食物的权利；第二，粮食生产极其依赖自然条件。
column6: has a right to|有权获得

Synthesis of an online debate*: These two unique aspects, one political, the other natural, make food production highly vulnerable and different from any other business.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 这两项独特性，一项关乎政治，一项关乎自然，使粮食生产特别容易受到冲击，也使它有别于其他任何行业。
column6: highly vulnerable|非常容易受到冲击的

Synthesis of an online debate*: At the same time, cultural values are highly entrenched in food and agricultural systems worldwide.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 与此同时，世界各地的食物体系和农业体系中都深深植根着文化价值观。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Farmers everywhere face major risks, including extreme weather, long-term climate change, and price volatility in input and product markets.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 各地农民都面临重大风险，包括极端天气、长期气候变化，以及农业投入品和农产品市场的价格波动。
online debate|网络讨论: long-term climate change|长期气候变化
column6: input and product markets|投入品和产品市场

Synthesis of an online debate*: However, smallholder farmers in developing countries must in addition deal with adverse environments, both natural, in terms of soil quality, rainfall, etc., and human, in terms of infrastructure, financial systems, markets, knowledge and technology.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 然而，发展中国家的小农还必须应付不利的环境条件。自然方面包括土质、降雨等，人为方面则涉及基础设施、金融体系、市场、知识和技术。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Counter-intuitively, hunger is prevalent among many smallholder farmers in the developing world.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 出乎人们的直觉，饥饿在发展中地区的许多小农户中相当普遍。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Participants in the online debate argued that our biggest challenge is to address the underlying causes of the agricultural system’s inability to ensure sufficient food for all, and they identified as drivers of this problem our dependency on fossil fuels and unsupportive government policies.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 网络讨论的参与者认为，我们面临的最大挑战是找出并解决农业体系无法保障人人获得充足食物的根本原因。他们指出，造成这一问题的因素包括我们对化石燃料的依赖，以及没能起到支持作用的政府政策。

Synthesis of an online debate*: On the question of mitigating the risks farmers face, most essayists called for greater state intervention.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 谈到如何减轻农民面临的风险，多数撰文者呼吁政府加大干预力度。

Synthesis of an online debate*: In his essay, Kanayo F. Nwanze, President of the International Fund for Agricultural Development, argued that governments can significantly reduce risks for farmers by providing basic services like roads to get produce more efficiently to markets, or water and food storage facilities to reduce losses.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 国际农业发展基金总裁卡纳约·恩旺泽在文章中指出，政府通过提供基础服务，可以大幅降低农民的风险；例如修路以便更高效地把农产品运到市场，或者提供储水、储粮设施以减少损失。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: International Fund for Agricultural Development|国际农业发展基金

Synthesis of an online debate*: Sophia Murphy, senior advisor to the Institute for Agriculture and Trade Policy, suggested that the procurement and holding of stocks by governments can also help mitigate wild swings in food prices by alleviating uncertainties about market supply.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 农业与贸易政策研究所高级顾问索菲娅·墨菲认为，政府采购并持有储备，能减少市场供应的不确定性，从而也有助于缓和食品价格的剧烈波动。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Shenggen Fan, Director General of the International Food Policy Research Institute, held up social safety nets and public welfare programmes in Ethiopia, Brazil and Mexico as valuable ways to address poverty among farming families and reduce their vulnerability to agriculture shocks.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 国际食物政策研究所所长樊胜根以埃塞俄比亚、巴西和墨西哥的社会安全网及公共福利项目为例，把这些措施视为应对农户贫困、减轻农户受农业冲击影响的有效办法。
online debate|网络讨论: International Food Policy Research Institute|国际食物政策研究所
column7: public welfare programmes|公共福利项目

Synthesis of an online debate*: However, some commentators responded that cash transfers to poor families do not necessarily translate into increased food security, as these programmes do not always strengthen food production or raise incomes.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 不过，有些评论者回应说，给贫困家庭发放现金并不一定能增进粮食安全，因为这些项目并不总能加强粮食生产或提高收入。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Regarding state subsidies for agriculture, Rokeya Kabir, Executive Director of Bangladesh Nari Progati Sangha, commented in her essay that these ‘have not compensated for the stranglehold exercised by private traders.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 谈及政府的农业补贴，孟加拉国妇女进步协会执行主任罗凯娅·卡比尔在文章中说，这些补贴“未能抵消私人商贩对市场的严密操控。

Synthesis of an online debate*: In fact, studies show that sixty percent of beneficiaries of subsidies are not poor, but rich landowners and non-farmer traders.’
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 事实上，研究表明，补贴受益者中有六成并非穷人，而是富有的土地所有者和不务农的商人。”

Synthesis of an online debate*: Nwanze, Murphy and Fan argued that private risk management tools, like private insurance, commodity futures markets, and rural finance can help small-scale producers mitigate risk and allow for investment in improvements.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 恩旺泽、墨菲和樊胜根认为，商业保险、商品期货市场以及农村金融等由私人部门提供的风险管理工具，可以帮助小规模生产者减轻风险，使他们能够投资改善生产。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: private risk management tools|私人部门的风险管理工具
column5: commodity futures markets|商品期货市场
column9: investment in improvements|用于改善生产的投资

Synthesis of an online debate*: Kabir warned that financial support schemes often encourage the adoption of high-input agricultural practices, which in the medium term may raise production costs beyond the value of their harvests.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 卡比尔警告，金融扶持计划往往鼓励人们采用高投入的耕作方式，从中期看，这可能使生产成本超过收成的价值。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: financial support schemes|金融扶持计划
column6: in the medium term|从中期看

Synthesis of an online debate*: Murphy noted that when futures markets become excessively financialised they can contribute to short-term price volatility, which increases farmers’ food insecurity.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 墨菲指出，期货市场过度金融化时，可能加剧短期价格波动，而这会使农民的粮食保障更加不稳定。
column6: short-term price volatility|短期价格波动

Synthesis of an online debate*: Many participants and commentators emphasised that greater transparency in markets is needed to mitigate the impact of volatility, and make evident whether adequate stocks and supplies are available.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 很多参与讨论和评论的人强调，市场需要有更高的透明度，才能减轻价格波动的影响，让人们看清现有的库存和供应是否充足。
column8: adequate stocks and supplies|充足的库存与供应

Synthesis of an online debate*: Others contended that agribusiness companies should be held responsible for paying for negative side effects.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 另一些人主张，农业企业应对其造成的不利副作用承担经济责任。
column5: be held responsible for|被要求承担责任
column6: negative side effects|不利的副作用

Synthesis of an online debate*: Many essayists mentioned climate change and its consequences for small-scale agriculture.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 许多撰文者提及气候变化及其对小规模农业的后果。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Fan explained that ‘in addition to reducing crop yields, climate change increases the magnitude and the frequency of extreme weather events, which increase smallholder vulnerability.”
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 樊胜根解释说：“气候变化不但会降低作物产量，还会增加极端天气事件的强度和频率，从而使小农户更容易遭受损害。”
column7: extreme weather events|极端天气事件
column8: smallholder vulnerability|小农户易受冲击的程度

Synthesis of an online debate*: The growing unpredictability of weather patterns increases farmers’ difficulty in managing weather-related risks.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 天气规律越来越难以预测，使农民更难管理天气带来的风险。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: growing unpredictability|日益增加的不可预测性
column6: weather-related risks|与天气有关的风险

Synthesis of an online debate*: According to this author, one solution would be to develop crop varieties that are more resilient to new climate trends and extreme weather patterns.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 这位作者认为，一种解决办法是培育作物新品种，使其更能适应新的气候趋势，更能抵御极端天气。
column7: extreme weather patterns|极端天气形态

Synthesis of an online debate*: Accordingly, Pat Mooney, co-founder and executive director of the ETC Group, suggested that ‘if we are to survive climate change, we must adopt policies that let peasants diversify the plant and animal species and varieties/breeds that make up our menus.’
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 为此，ETC组织共同创办人兼执行主任帕特·穆尼建议：“如果我们要在气候变化中生存下来，就得采取政策，让农民能丰富餐桌所依赖的动植物物种和品种。”

Synthesis of an online debate*: Some participating authors and commentators argued in favour of community-based and autonomous risk management strategies through collective action groups, co-operatives or producers’ groups.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 一些参与撰文和评论的人赞成以社区为基础、自主进行风险管理，通过集体行动小组、合作社或生产者组织来实行。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: argued in favour of|主张支持
column6: collective action groups|集体行动小组

Synthesis of an online debate*: Such groups enhance market opportunities for small-scale producers, reduce marketing costs and synchronise buying and selling with seasonal price conditions.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 这类组织能为小规模生产者增加市场机会、降低销售成本，并让买卖活动与季节性的价格变化相配合。
column7: seasonal price conditions|季节性价格状况

Synthesis of an online debate*: According to Murphy, ‘collective action offers an important way for farmers to strengthen their political and economic bargaining power, and to reduce their business risks.’
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 墨菲说：“集体行动是农民增强政治和经济谈判能力、降低经营风险的重要途径。”

Synthesis of an online debate*: One commentator, Giel Ton, warned that collective action does not come as a free good.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 评论者希尔·通提醒说，集体行动并非毫无代价。
column6: a free good|无须付出代价的东西

Synthesis of an online debate*: It takes time, effort and money to organise, build trust and to experiment.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 组织行动、建立信任、进行尝试，都需要时间、精力和金钱。

Synthesis of an online debate*: Others, like Marcel Vernooij and Marcel Beukeboom, suggested that in order to ‘apply what we already know’, all stakeholders, including business, government, scientists and civil society, must work together, starting at the beginning of the value chain.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 马塞尔·弗诺伊、马塞尔·伯克博姆等人提出，为了“把已有知识付诸实践”，包括企业、政府、科学家和公民社会在内的所有利益相关方，必须从价值链的起点开始合作。
online debate|网络讨论: apply what we already know|把已有知识付诸实践

Synthesis of an online debate*: Some participants explained that market price volatility is often worsened by the presence of intermediary purchasers who, taking advantage of farmers’ vulnerability, dictate prices.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 有些参与者解释说，中间收购商往往利用农民的弱势地位自行定价，他们的存在常常加剧市场价格波动。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: market price volatility|市场价格波动

Synthesis of an online debate*: One commentator suggested farmers can gain greater control over prices and minimise price volatility by selling directly to consumers.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 一名评论者认为，农民直接向消费者销售，就能更好地掌控价格，把价格波动尽量降到最低。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: gain greater control over|加强对……的掌控

Synthesis of an online debate*: Similarly, Sonali Bisht, founder and advisor to the Institute of Himalayan Environmental Research and Education (INHERE), India, wrote that community-supported agriculture, where consumers invest in local farmers by subscription and guarantee producers a fair price, is a risk-sharing model worth more attention.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 同样，印度喜马拉雅环境研究与教育研究所（INHERE）的创办人兼顾问索纳莉·比什特写道，在社区支持农业中，消费者通过认购来支持当地农户，并保证生产者能获得公平的价格。这种分担风险的模式值得更多关注。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: founder and advisor|创办人兼顾问
online debate|网络讨论: Himalayan Environmental Research and Education|喜马拉雅环境研究与教育
column11: worth more attention|值得更多关注

Synthesis of an online debate*: Direct food distribution systems not only encourage small-scale agriculture but also give consumers more control over the food they consume, she wrote.
一场网络讨论的综述*。: 她写道，食品直供体系既能鼓励小规模农业，也能让消费者更好地掌控自己吃什么。
Synthesis|n. 综合整理: Direct food distribution systems|食品直供体系
